hooks.command: cd /Users/fabio/workspace/ai-coding-noble-desktop && git add -A && if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then files=$(git diff --cached --name-only | paste -sd ', ' -); if git commit -q -m "Update ${files}" 2>/dev/null && git push -q 2>/dev/null; then printf '{"systemMessage": "✅ Auto-commit: committed & pushed — %s"}' "${files}"; else printf '{"systemMessage": "⚠️ Auto-commit: commit or push failed — run git push manually"}'; fi; else printf '{"systemMessage": "ℹ️ Auto-commit: no changes to commit"}'; fi; true
